question: Among hospital admissions with a heart failure diagnosis, what percentage ended in death during that admission?

output_spec.description: Percentage of hospital admissions with a heart failure diagnosis that ended in death during that admission

concepts.evidence: admissions table description: one row per hospital admission; hadm_id is unique per row
Code candidates list shows 4280 and 4281 but is truncated; use prefix '428%' to capture all heart failure ICD-9 codes

concepts.term: ended in death during that admission
percentage of hospital admissions with a heart failure diagnosis that ended in death during that admission
concepts.evidence: Computed as (count of admissions satisfying HF diagnosis and hospital_expire_flag=1) ÷ (count of admissions satisfying HF diagnosis) × 100
derived_from: ended in death during that admission

tables.name: admissions
tables.description: One row per hospital admission: admission and discharge times, admission type and location, insurance, demographics, admitting diagnosis text, and in-hospital death.

columns.name: row_id
columns.description: Row number within this table; not an identifier, never use it for joins (role: row_number)

columns.name: subject_id
columns.description: Patient identifier (PATIENTS) (role: reference; references patients.subject_id)

columns.name: hadm_id
columns.description: Hospital admission identifier (unique per row) (role: identifier)

columns.name: admittime
columns.description: Admission time (shifted) (role: time)

columns.name: dischtime
columns.description: Discharge time (shifted) (role: time)

columns.name: deathtime
columns.description: Time of in-hospital death; null if the patient did not die in hospital (role: time)

columns.name: admission_type
columns.description: One of 'ELECTIVE', 'URGENT', 'EMERGENCY', 'NEWBORN' (role: category)

columns.name: admission_location
columns.description: Where the patient was admitted from, e.g. 'EMERGENCY ROOM ADMIT', 'PHYS REFERRAL/NORMAL DELI', 'TRANSFER FROM HOSP/EXTRAM', 'CLINIC REFERRAL/PREMATURE' (role: category)

columns.name: discharge_location
columns.description: Where the patient went after discharge, e.g. 'HOME', 'HOME HEALTH CARE', 'SNF', 'REHAB/DISTINCT PART HOSP', 'DEAD/EXPIRED' (role: category)

columns.name: insurance
columns.description: One of 'Medicare', 'Private', 'Medicaid', 'Government', 'Self Pay' (role: category)

columns.name: language
columns.description: Preferred language, 4-letter uppercase abbreviations such as 'ENGL', 'SPAN'; often null (role: text)

columns.name: religion
columns.description: Religion, uppercase free text, e.g. 'CATHOLIC', 'NOT SPECIFIED' (role: category)

columns.name: marital_status
columns.description: Uppercase, e.g. 'MARRIED', 'SINGLE', 'WIDOWED', 'DIVORCED', 'SEPARATED' (role: category)

columns.name: ethnicity
columns.description: Uppercase free text with subgroups, e.g. 'WHITE', 'BLACK/AFRICAN AMERICAN', 'HISPANIC OR LATINO', 'ASIAN - CHINESE', 'UNKNOWN/NOT SPECIFIED'; use prefix patterns such as 'ASIAN%' for groups (role: category)

columns.name: edregtime
columns.description: Time registered in the emergency department (role: time)

columns.name: edouttime
columns.description: Time left the emergency department (role: time)

columns.name: diagnosis
columns.description: Free-text preliminary admitting diagnosis (uppercase), not coded; use diagnoses_icd for coded diagnoses (role: text)

columns.name: hospital_expire_flag
columns.description: 1 if the patient died during this admission, else 0 (role: flag)

columns.name: has_chartevents_data
columns.description: 1 if the admission has ICU charted data (role: flag)

tables.name: diagnoses_icd
tables.description: Hospital-assigned ICD-9 diagnosis codes for each admission, assigned at discharge for billing, ordered by priority.

columns.name: row_id
columns.description: Row number within this table; not an identifier, never use it for joins (role: row_number)

columns.name: subject_id
columns.description: Patient identifier (PATIENTS) (role: reference; references patients.subject_id)

columns.name: hadm_id
columns.description: Hospital admission identifier (ADMISSIONS) (role: reference; references admissions.hadm_id)

columns.name: seq_num
columns.description: Priority of the diagnosis within the admission; 1 = primary diagnosis (role: number)

columns.name: icd9_code
columns.description: ICD-9-CM diagnosis code stored as text WITHOUT the dot: 250.00 is '25000', 401.9 is '4019', V45.81 is 'V4581' (role: code; references d_icd_diagnoses.icd9_code)

assumptions.heart_failure_diagnosis_scope: use any diagnosis code (not only primary)
assumptions.heart_failure_code_mapping: use icd9_code LIKE '428%' to capture full heart failure family
assumptions.numerator_denominator_filters: denominator applies only HF filter; numerator applies HF filter and death filter
assumptions.ambiguity_1: Whether 'heart failure diagnosis' refers to any diagnosis code or only the principal diagnosis -> Any diagnosis code on the admission record indicating heart failure

query_conventions.rule: These combinations repeat within one admission: diagnoses_icd (hadm_id, icd9_code), procedures_icd (hadm_id, icd9_code), drgcodes (hadm_id, drg_type). Count DISTINCT admissions or codes, not rows.

Some codes have no entry in their dictionary table: diagnoses_icd.icd9_code -> d_icd_diagnoses, procedures_icd.icd9_code -> d_icd_procedures. Use a LEFT JOIN to the dictionary (an INNER JOIN drops those rows) and report unlabeled codes as such.

Some end times precede their start times: admissions (dischtime < admittime), admissions (edouttime < edregtime), prescriptions (enddate < startdate), procedureevents_mv (endtime < starttime). Exclude those rows when computing durations or lengths of stay; keep them for counts.
Identify in-hospital death with admissions.hospital_expire_flag = 1, not by testing deathtime against the admission window.

ICD-9 codes are stored as text without the decimal point ('4019' is 401.9; E and V codes keep their letter) in diagnoses_icd.icd9_code, procedures_icd.icd9_code, d_icd_diagnoses.icd9_code, d_icd_procedures.icd9_code. Compare as strings; never cast to numbers.
admission_type = 'NEWBORN' marks neonatal admissions (age about 0); exclude them for adult cohort questions unless newborns are asked about.

Some text values have leading or trailing spaces, so an exact match fails (every APR row has drg_type 'APR ', so drg_type = 'APR' finds nothing): admissions.diagnosis, d_items.label, d_items.abbreviation, drgcodes.drg_type, microbiologyevents.org_name, prescriptions.drug, prescriptions.drug_name_poe, prescriptions.drug_name_generic, prescriptions.gsn, prescriptions.prod_strength, prescriptions.dose_val_rx, prescriptions.form_val_disp, procedureevents_mv.location. Compare with trim(column) = 'value', or use LIKE / ILIKE patterns.

clarification_policy.reason: Resolved without user input; see assumptions.
